blocks.goal: Reduce size/complexity of Functions by extracting the private helper getAsBoolean into a small helper class so the main class holds only public API and nested types.

ops.details: Create a new final helper class FunctionsInternal in package org.apache.commons.lang3 and move the private static method getAsBoolean to it as a package-private/static method. The implementation remains the same but delegates rethrow via Functions.rethrow. Make the new class have a private constructor to prevent instantiation.

Replace internal calls to the removed private method getAsBoolean(...) with calls to FunctionsInternal.getAsBoolean(...). Specifically update the two overloads of test(...) that previously called the private method.
No external imports required since FunctionsInternal is in the same package. Ensure file has package declaration 'package org.apache.commons.lang3;'.
